value.rationale: The lower side is a natural missing counterpart to the classical discrete upper problem. For a fixed atom profile it gives a positive, computable anti-collapse constant, identifies all closure extremizers by cumulative-mass cuts, and combines with the known upper projection result to classify the entire attainable standardized expected-maximum range.
